title: The neighbouring Morpho Instance records no maxExchangeRate despite the stated controller requirement
content:
Two Morpho Instances on Base sit adjacent in the Atlas and are near-identical in every recorded respect. A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.3.3.1.1 (Grove x Steakhouse High Yield Vault USDC, token `grove-bbqUSDC`) and A.6.1.1.2.2.6.1.3.3.2 (Steakhouse Prime Instant USDC Morpho Vault V2, token `steakUSDC`) share a network, a target protocol, the same USDC underlying asset address, `Pending` RRC coverage, and matching 20,000,000 USDC inflow limits with unlimited outflow.

They differ in one place. The Prime Instance carries a **Max Exchange Rate** subsection at .3.2.2.4.3; the High Yield Instance has no equivalent — its Rate Limits section ends at outflow (.3.1.1.2.4.2).

That is difficult to reconcile with the Prime Instance's own text, which states that "controllers **now** have protections that require a `maxExchangeRate` to be set for deposits." If the requirement is a property of the controllers, it should bind both Instances; if it binds both, the High Yield Instance has a configured value that the Atlas does not record.

Either reading is a finding. Under the first, a live 20,000,000 USDC deposit path into a yield-bearing vault has no valuation bound. Under the second, the Atlas is incomplete for a control it elsewhere describes as mandatory — and the reader cannot tell which, because the schema has no slot for "this control is set elsewhere."

The general lesson concerns how retrofitted requirements propagate. A control introduced as "now required" applies cleanly to Instances configured afterwards and leaves an undocumented tail of earlier ones. Auditing that tail requires reading for **absence** across sibling documents, which is exactly what a uniform schema makes possible and a reader scanning one document at a time will miss.
description: Grove x Steakhouse High Yield Vault USDC has the same network, protocol and 20m limits as Steakhouse Prime but omits the parameter that the adjacent document says controllers now require for deposits.
